items.title: A Shrine Built Against Disease
items.hook: This shrine is tied to keeping sickness away.
items.task: Find one sign of the Gion festival: a float storehouse, a plaque, or a lion-dog.
items.reveal: Gion Matsuri grew from rites meant to calm epidemic fear. Check dates and names before this is live.

items.title: How Do You Wake a God?
items.task: Watch worshippers. What do they do with coin, bell, bow and clap?
items.reveal: Many people toss a coin, bow, clap, then bow again. Local habit varies. Do not correct strangers.
items.notes: Do not teach one universal sequence as law.
